--로그체스 어빌리티
--단순히 Option & BattleAddOn을 부여
--로그체스 시스템 일정 수치 부여에도 사용
local local_class = newclass('CommonAddAbility')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(cs_ability, level, params)
	self.cs_ability = cs_ability
	self.level = level
	self.option_info_table = {}
	self.battle_addon_info_table = {}
	self.character_lua_option_dict = {}
	self.condition_info_table = {}

	self.on_battle_enter_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_enter_event(e) end
	self.on_battle_leave_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_leave_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), self.on_battle_leave_event_func)

	self.coop_class = {
		['Melee'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Melee,
		['Projectile'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile,
		['Tanker'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Tanker,
		['Supporter'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Supporter
	}

	self:configure_addon_info(params)
	self:configure_option_info(params)
	self:set_condition(params)

	self.energy_max_adder = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'EnergyMaxValueAdder')
	if self.energy_max_adder ~= nil then
		self.energy_max_adder = self.energy_max_adder[level - 1]
	else
		self.energy_max_adder = 0
	end

	self.energy_min_adder = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'EnergyMinValueAdder')
	if self.energy_min_adder ~= nil then
		self.energy_min_adder = self.energy_min_adder[level - 1]
	else
		self.energy_min_adder = 0
	end

	self.energy_speed_adder = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'EnergySpeedAdder')
	if self.energy_speed_adder ~= nil then
		self.energy_speed_adder = self.energy_speed_adder[level - 1]
	else
		self.energy_speed_adder = 0
	end

	self.respawn_time_adder = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'RespawnTimeAdder')
	if self.respawn_time_adder ~= nil then
		self.respawn_time_adder = self.respawn_time_adder[level - 1]
	else
		self.respawn_time_adder = 0
	end

	print('Ability Init : ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id .. ', level: ' .. level)
end

--lua option으로 구현된 특수 기믹 대상으로 전투 기준으로 start/force_cancel 호출
function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	for character, options in pairs(self.character_lua_option_dict) do
		if e.FieldObject == character then
			for i = 1, #options do
				print('option triggered  - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id  .. ' : ' .. character.Name .. ', ' .. options[i].Id)
				local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerStageOptionCommand.CreateDefault(character, options[i].Id)
				command_util.publish_cmd(character.Owner, cmd)
			end

			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	for character, options in pairs(self.character_lua_option_dict) do
		if e.FieldObject == character then
			for i = 1, #options do
				if options[i].StageAppliedOption ~= nil then
					print('option canceled  - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id  .. ' : ' .. character.Name .. ', ' .. options[i].Id)
					options[i].StageAppliedOption:ForceCancel()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:configure_option_info(params)
	local option_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'OptionId', -1)

	if option_id == -1 then
		local idx = 1
		option_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'OptionId_' .. idx, -1)

		while option_id ~= -1 do
			table.insert(self.option_info_table, self:get_option_info(params, idx))

			idx = idx + 1
			option_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'OptionId_' .. idx, -1)
		end
	else
		table.insert(self.option_info_table, self:get_option_info(params))
	end
end

function local_class:get_option_info(params, idx)
	if idx ~= nil then
		local target_class_str = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'TargetClass_' .. idx, 'All')
		local list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'OptionLevel_' .. idx)
		return {
			id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'OptionId_' .. idx),
			target_class = target_class_str == 'All'
					and nil
					or self.coop_class[target_class_str],
			level = list ~= nil and list[math.min(list.Count - 1, self.level - 1)] or 0,
		}
	else
		local target_class_str = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'TargetClass', 'All')
		local list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'OptionLevel')
		return {
			id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'OptionId'),
			target_class = target_class_str == 'All'
					and nil
					or self.coop_class[target_class_str],
			level = list ~= nil and list[math.min(list.Count - 1, self.level - 1)] or 0,
		}
	end
end

function local_class:configure_addon_info(params)
	local battle_addon_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnId', -1)

	if battle_addon_id == -1 then
		local idx = 1
		battle_addon_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnId_' .. idx, -1)

		while battle_addon_id ~= -1 do
			table.insert(self.battle_addon_info_table, self:get_addon_info(params, idx))

			idx = idx + 1
			battle_addon_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnId_' .. idx, -1)
		end
	else
		table.insert(self.battle_addon_info_table, self:get_addon_info(params))
	end
end

function local_class:get_addon_info(params, idx)
	if idx ~= nil then
		local list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnLevel_' .. idx)
		return {
			id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnId_' .. idx),
			level = list ~= nil and list[math.min(list.Count - 1, self.level - 1)] or 0,
		}
	else
		local list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnLevel')
		return {
			id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BattleAddOnId'),
			level = list ~= nil and list[math.min(list.Count - 1, self.level - 1)] or 0,
		}
	end
end

function local_class:set_condition(params)
	local condition = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Condition')
	if condition == nil or condition == '' then
		local idx = 0
		while true do
			idx = idx + 1
			local condition_func = self:get_condition_function(params, idx)
			if condition_func then
				table.insert(self.condition_info_table, condition_func)
			else
				break
			end
		end
		return
	end

	local condition_func = self:get_condition_function(params)
	if condition_func then
		table.insert(self.condition_info_table, condition_func)
	end
end

function local_class:get_condition_function(params, idx)
	idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(idx, 0)
	local key_str = idx > 0 and 'Condition_' .. idx or 'Condition'

	local condition = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, key_str)
	if condition == nil or condition == '' then
		return nil
	end

	local class_key = idx > 0 and 'ConditionTargetClass_' .. idx or 'ConditionTargetClass'

	local condition_func
	if condition == 'SameElementalType' then
		local count_key = idx > 0 and 'ElementalTypeCount_' .. idx or 'ElementalTypeCount'

		local count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, count_key, -1)
		local target_class_str = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, class_key, 'All')
		local target_class = target_class_str == 'All'
				and nil or self.coop_class[target_class_str]
		condition_func = function()
			local rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
			if rc_sub_system.Deck == nil then
				return false
			end
			if count < 1 then
				return rogue_chess_util.is_all_same_elemental_type(target_class)
			else
				local _, highest_value = rogue_chess_util.count_elemental_type_in_rosters(target_class)
				return highest_value >= count
			end
		end
	elseif condition == 'HaveClass' then
		local target_class_str = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, class_key, 'All')
		local target_class = target_class_str == 'All'
				and nil or self.coop_class[target_class_str]
		condition_func = function()
			return self:check_has_class_in_roster(target_class)
		end
	else
		condition_func = function() return true end
	end

	return condition_func
end

function local_class:on_stage_load(e)
end

function local_class:activate_battle_addons()
	if not self:check_can_apply() then
		return
	end

	--test
	if #self.battle_addon_info_table == 0 then
		return
	end

	print('activate_battle_addons - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id)
	for i = 1, #self.battle_addon_info_table do
		local info = self.battle_addon_info_table[i]

		if stage.BattleAddOnManager:SetState(info.id, info.level, true) then
			return
		end

		stage.BattleAddOnManager:Add(info.id, info.level)
	end
	--test
	print('end activate_battle_addons - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id)
end

function local_class:add_option_to_roster(rosters)
	if not self:check_can_apply() then
		return
	end

	--test
	if #self.option_info_table == 0 then
		return
	end

	print('activate_options - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id)
	for i = 1, #self.option_info_table do
		local info = self.option_info_table[i]

		for j = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
			local character = rosters[j]
			if info.target_class == nil or character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass == info.target_class then
				local option = CS.Oak.OptionManager.CreateOption(info.id, info.level)

				print('option added: ' .. character.Name .. ' - ID: ' .. info.id .. ', Level: ' .. info.level .. ', Class :' .. (info.target_class == nil and 'All' or info.target_class:ToString()))
				if not CS.Oak.CharacterOptionStats.CheckAndAddExistingOptionLevel(character.CharacterInfo.CharacterOptions, option) then
					character.CharacterInfo.CharacterOptions:Add(option)
				end

				if lua_helper.type_compare(option, CS.Oak.LuaOption) then
					if self.character_lua_option_dict[character] == nil then
						self.character_lua_option_dict[character] = {}
					end

					table.insert(self.character_lua_option_dict[character], option)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	print('end activate_options - ' .. self.cs_ability.Spec.Id)
end

function local_class:check_has_class_in_roster(target_class)
	if target_class == nil then
		return false
	end

	local rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	if rc_sub_system.Deck == nil then
		return false
	end

	local rosters = rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local character = rosters[i].Character
		if character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass == target_class then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:check_can_apply()
	for _, condition_func in ipairs(self.condition_info_table) do
		if not condition_func() then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt)
end

function local_class:get_energy_max_adder()
	return self.energy_max_adder
end

function local_class:get_energy_min_adder()
	return self.energy_min_adder
end

function local_class:get_energy_speed_adder()
	return self.energy_speed_adder
end

function local_class:get_respawn_time_adder()
	return self.respawn_time_adder
end

function local_class:dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), self.on_battle_leave_event_func)
	self.character_lua_option_dict = nil
	self.option_info_table = nil
	self.battle_addon_info_table = nil
	self.condition_info_table = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_ability, level, params)
		return local_class(cs_ability, level, params)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessAdelaRobot')

function local_class:set_target_character(character)
	self.boss_character = character
	self.boss_character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_anim(self.boss_character, {name = 'wait'})
end

function local_class:load_resource_routine(param_table)
	self.params = param_table
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_adelarobot_overload_booting')
end

function local_class:level_enter_routine()
	if is_unity_null(self.boss_character) then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.boss_character, {name = 'wait'})

	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('level_boss').position
	local camera_start_pos = marker_pos + unity_class.vector3(0,0,3.8)

	stage.StageCamera:Move(camera_start_pos, 0.0, nil, true)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	stage.StageCamera:Move(marker_pos, 2.0, nil, true)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	-- 캐시
	local up_dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 1, -1).normalized
	local spine_transform = self.boss_character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	local beam_offset = unity_class.vector3(0.3, 0.7, 0.2)
	local bone_hand_name = 'side_handB'
	local fx_target_bone_hand = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.boss_character.SpineController, bone_hand_name)

	local follower_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('boss_chancellor_hand_bone_follower')
	local bone_follower = follower_object:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = true
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.boss_character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone(bone_hand_name)

	local fire_fx
	local fire_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_chancellor_appear')

	-- appear 애니메이션
	local appear_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.boss_character.SpineController, 'appear') + 2
	character_util.set_anim(self.boss_character, {name = 'appear', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.params.appear_sfx)

	-- 연출 루틴
	local fx_instantiated = false
	local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < appear_duration do
		time_passed = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s
		local hand_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(fx_target_bone_hand, spine_transform)
		if time_passed > 0.7 then
			if fire_fx_pool ~= nil and not fx_instantiated then
				fx_instantiated = true
				fire_fx = fire_fx_pool:Instantiate(hand_pos + beam_offset);
			end
		end

		if fx_instantiated and not is_unity_null(fire_fx) then
			local hand_rot = fx_target_bone_hand.WorldRotationX
			hand_rot = (hand_rot > 0 and hand_rot or (360 + hand_rot)) * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad
			local direction = -unity_class.vector3(math.cos(hand_rot), 0, math.sin(hand_rot))
			local dir = (direction - unity_class.vector3.Dot(direction, up_dir) * up_dir).normalized
			local dir_perp = unity_class.vector3.Dot(dir, up_dir) * up_dir + unity_class.vector3.Cross(dir, up_dir)
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir_perp, up_dir)
			fire_fx.transform.rotation = rot
			dir = unity_class.vector3(dir.x * 2.2, dir.y * 2.3, dir.z * 2.3)
			fire_fx.transform.localPosition = hand_pos - dir + beam_offset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- fire_fx 타임리밋 이펙트로 가정, 강제로 꺼주지 않음
	if not is_unity_null(fire_fx) then
		object_pool_extensions.DisposeViaType(fire_fx, false)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(self.boss_character)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.rc_sub_system = nil
	self.params = nil
	self.boss_character = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_ability, level, params)
		return local_class(cs_ability, level, params)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessScreenPlay')

function local_class:init(cs_handler, scene)
	self.cs_handler = cs_handler

	self.roguechess_screenplay_data = require('RogueChess/RogueChessScreenPlayData.lua')
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
end

function local_class:load_boss_enter_transition(boss)
	return util.cs_generator(self.load_boss_enter_transition_routine, self, boss)
end

function local_class:load_boss_enter_transition_routine(boss)
	if self.current_boss_script then
		self.current_boss_script:dispose()
		self.current_boss_script = nil
	end

	local asset_name = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(boss).SpineAssetName.assetName
	local current_info = self.roguechess_screenplay_data[asset_name]
	if current_info and current_info.controller then
		self.current_boss_script = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('RogueChess/RogueChess' .. current_info.controller)
	else
		self.current_boss_script = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('RogueChess/RogueChessDefault')
	end

	self.current_boss_script:set_target_character(boss)
	coroutine.yield(self.current_boss_script:load_resource_routine(current_info.param_table))
end

function local_class:boss_level_enter()
	return util.cs_generator(self.boss_level_enter_routine, self)
end

function local_class:boss_level_enter_routine()
	self.current_boss_script:level_enter_routine()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.current_boss_script then
		self.current_boss_script:dispose()
		self.current_boss_script = nil
	end

	self.rc_sub_system = nil
	self.roguechess_screenplay_data = nil
	self.cs_handler = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_ability, level, params)
		return local_class(cs_ability, level, params)
	end,
}

require('base/class')
local adventurerchris_class = newclass('adventurerchris')

function adventurerchris_class:add_callback(name, func)
	if self.callbacks == nil then

local local_class = newclass("Christmas1At4Controller")

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- HACK: 해당 코드는 아래 Hack 루틴이 모두 사라지면 삭제 필요!
	local csg_type = typeof(CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame)
	xlua.private_accessible(csg_type)
	self.is_game_playing = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:need_on_launch()
	local christmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(christmas_main_quest_id)
	-- 컨트롤을 뺐어옴
	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_launch(start_point_name)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_routine, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hack_exception_prevent_routine, self))
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		user_party[i]:HideWeapon(true)
	end

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_get'
	)

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.resource_holder,
			'effects/stage/base', 'star_piece', function(prefab)
					self.star_piece = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
			end)
	self.star_piece.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 8.0
	self.star_piece.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-35, 0, 0)
	self.star_piece.transform.position = vector(999,999,999)
	self.star_piece.transform:GetChild(1).transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	local christmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(christmas_main_quest_id)


	self:force_disable_game_pad_state()

	-- 컨트롤을 뺐어옴
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress < 12 then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.Play, 0)
	elseif quest_progress ~= nil then
		camera_util.move_async(vector(99999, 0, 99999), 0.01)
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.Play, 1)
	end

	self:recover_game_pad_state()
end

function local_class:force_disable_game_pad_state()
	-- FIXME : 게임패드로 정상적으로 플레이 할 수 있게 하고, 강제로 컨트롤 유형 변경하는 코드 척살할 것
	-- GamePad == 2
	if CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetInt('ControllerType', 0) == 2 then
		local controller_type = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.IsPC
				and CS.Oak.UI.OptionsControllerSettings.ControllerType.KeyboardAndMouse
				or CS.Oak.UI.OptionsControllerSettings.ControllerType.None
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerLinkChangedEvent.Create(controller_type))
	end
end

function local_class:recover_game_pad_state()
	-- FIXME : 게임패드로 정상적으로 플레이 할 수 있게 하고, 강제로 컨트롤 유형 변경하는 코드 척살할 것
	-- GamePad == 2
	if CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetInt('ControllerType', 0) == 2 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerLinkChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.UI.OptionsControllerSettings.ControllerType.GamePad))
	end
end

function local_class:hack_exception_prevent_routine()

	while CS.Oak.Game.Instance.CurrentGameMode ~= CS.Oak.GameMode.Lobby do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- Game Mode 가 로비 라면 모든 리스트를 지워 버린다.
	local g = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance

	-- 정상 적인 해제 라면 무시한다
	if g == nil or g.monsterPoolMap == nil then return end
	xlua.private_accessible(typeof(CS.Oak.MessageSystem))

	-- 게임 패드 상태를 다시 원복
	self:recover_game_pad_state()

	-- HACK: Super Hack - 가장 마지막에 해당 메시지를 구독 할수 밖에 없는 구조로 날려 버린다.
	local touch_callbacks = CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance.subscribeCallbacks[typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent)]
	-- pause event 뒤에 존재함. 그래서 -2
	touch_callbacks:RemoveAt(touch_callbacks.Count - 1)

	if touch_callbacks.Count == 0 then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance.subscribeCallbacks:Remove(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	local joypad_callbacks = CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance.subscribeCallbacks[typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent)]
	joypad_callbacks:RemoveAt(joypad_callbacks.Count - 1)

	if joypad_callbacks.Count == 0 then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance.subscribeCallbacks:Remove(typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(g.gameObject)
	CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance = nil
end

function local_class:player_damage_routine()
	local player_rudolph = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerFighter.gameObject.transform:Find('rudolph')
	local rudolph_spine = player_rudolph.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	local rudolph_spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	rudolph_spine:ClearTrack(rudolph_spine_track)
	rudolph_spine:SetAnimation(rudolph_spine_track, 'idle', true)

	local player_knight = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerFighter.gameObject.transform:Find('knight_female_1')
	local knight_spine = player_knight.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	local knight_spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	knight_spine:ClearTrack(knight_spine_track)
	knight_spine:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	knight_spine:SetAnimation(knight_spine_track, 'eat', true)

	local player_princess = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerFighter.gameObject.transform:Find('princess')
	local princess_spine = player_princess.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	local princess_spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	princess_spine:ClearTrack(princess_spine_track)
	princess_spine:SetAnimation(princess_spine_track, 'success', true)

	while CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance == nil or
			CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.miniGameState ~= CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGameState.Playing do

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.is_game_playing == false then
			return
		end
	end

	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()

		-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창 제거 (루아에서 NavigationBar GetChild 코드 안쓰게 수정)
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:SetActiveFieldResourceBoxAndSettingAndChatButton(false)
	end

	knight_spine:ClearTrack(knight_spine_track)
	knight_spine:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	knight_spine:SetAnimation(knight_spine_track, 'eat', true)

	princess_spine:ClearTrack(princess_spine_track)
	princess_spine:SetAnimation(princess_spine_track, 'success', true)

	local cur_hp = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerInfo.playerHp

	-- 해당 상태가 True 이면 계속 돈다
	while self.is_game_playing == true and CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance ~= nil do

		if not is_unity_null(stage.FieldUIMiniMap) then
			stage.FieldUIMiniMap.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		if cur_hp ~= CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerInfo.playerHp then
			cur_hp = CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerInfo.playerHp

			if cur_hp <= 0 then
				return
			end

			rudolph_spine:DamageRedPulse()
			rudolph_spine:DamageSquish(1.0)

			knight_spine:ClearTrack(knight_spine_track)
			knight_spine:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
			knight_spine:SetAnimation(knight_spine_track, 'embarrassed', true)
			knight_spine:DamageRedPulse()
			knight_spine:DamageSquish(1.0)

			princess_spine:ClearTrack(princess_spine_track)
			princess_spine:SetAnimation(princess_spine_track, 'embarrassed', true)
			princess_spine:DamageRedPulse()
			princess_spine:DamageSquish(1.0)

			wait_for_sec(1)
			knight_spine:ClearTrack(knight_spine_track)
			knight_spine:SetEmotion('attack', true)
			knight_spine:SetAnimation(knight_spine_track, 'eat', true)

			princess_spine:ClearTrack(princess_spine_track)
			princess_spine:SetAnimation(princess_spine_track, 'success', true)
		end

		if CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.miniGameState ~= CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGameState.Playing then
			self.is_game_playing = false
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(self.star_piece) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.star_piece)
		self.star_piece = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.resource_holder) then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.resource_holder = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.cs_controller = nil
	CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) and e.Name == 'ChristmasShooterGame' then

		if e.Success then
			-- 스테이지 클리어
			CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap('xm_1_4_exit', 'xm_1_5', nil, true, nil)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_over, self))
		end

		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params[0] == "ChristmasShooterGame" and e.Params[1] == "GameOver" and e.Params[2] then
			self.wave_num = tonumber(e.Params[2])
			return true
		elseif e.Params ~= nil and e.Params[0] == "ChristmasShooterGame" and e.Params[1] == "purpleCoin" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.get_purple_coin, self, tonumber(e.Params[2]), e.Params[3]))
			return true
		elseif e.Params ~= nil and e.Params[0] == "ChristmasShooterGame" and e.Params[1] == "StarPiece" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.get_star_piece, self, tonumber(e.Params[2]), e.Params[3]))
			return true
		elseif e.Params ~= nil and e.Params[0] == 'ChristmasShooterGameLoaded' then
			self.is_game_playing = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.player_damage_routine, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 게임 재시작 시 기존에 받았던 Wave의 번호를 토대로 재입장
function local_class:game_over()
	-- 웨이브 수가 0 이하로 떨어지지 않도록 처리 필요
	self.wave_num = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(1, self.wave_num, self.wave_num)

	self.is_game_playing = false

	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	self:force_disable_game_pad_state()

	-- 해당 로직은 이미 인트로 부분을 봤을 경우에만 해당하므로 게임 인덱스 1로 고정
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.Play, 1, self.wave_num)

	self:recover_game_pad_state()
end

function local_class:get_purple_coin(coin_number, pos_string)
	local pos = {}
	local str_1 = pos_string:gsub('%s+', "")
	local str_2 = str_1:gsub('%(', "")
	local str_3 = str_2:gsub('%)', "")

	for strNumber in string.gmatch(str_3, "[^,]+") do
		table.insert(pos, tonumber(strNumber))
	end

	local purple_coin = get_field_object('purple_coin_' .. coin_number)
	purple_coin.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 15.0
	purple_coin.transform.position = vector(pos[1], pos[2], pos[3])
	purple_coin.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-35, 0, 0)
	purple_coin.transform:Find("shadow").gameObject:SetActive(false)
	message_system:Send(purple_coin.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))
end

function local_class:get_star_piece(star_piece_num, pos_string)

	if CS.Oak.StageProgress.Current:HasStarPiece('star_piece_' .. star_piece_num) then
		return
	end

	local pos = {}
	local str_1 = pos_string:gsub('%s+', "")
	local str_2 = str_1:gsub('%(', "")
	local str_3 = str_2:gsub('%)', "")

	for strNumber in string.gmatch(str_3, "[^,]+") do
		table.insert(pos, tonumber(strNumber))
	end
	self.star_piece.transform.position = vector(pos[1], pos[2], pos[3])

	local get_star_piece = get_field_object('star_piece_' .. star_piece_num)
	message_system:Send(get_star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	local start_pos = self.star_piece.transform.position
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 1 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.star_piece.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos,
				CS.Oak.ChristmasShooterGame.instance.playerFighter.transform.position, time_passed)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(self.star_piece.transform.position)
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 30

	if not is_unity_null(self.star_piece) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.star_piece)
		self.star_piece = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene);
	end
}

---@alias Predicate string | function
---@alias Selector string | function
---@alias Comparer string | function

local ordering = require('base/LINQ/Ordering.lua')

---@class LINQ
linq = {}

linq.__index = linq
setmetatable(linq, {
	__call = function(self, ...)
		return self.new(...)
	end
})

local lambda_pattern = [[^%s*%(?(.-)%)?%s*=>%s*(.-)%s*$]]
local return_pattern = [[%b()]]

--#region Locals
---@class LinqSequence
local empty_sequence

local table_mt = { __index = table }

local function new_table()
	return setmetatable({}, table_mt)
end

-- load 함수 구현체가 존재하면 해당 함수를 할당하고, 없다면 에러 메시지 띄우는 함수 할당.
-- 함수 구현체 자체가 없어서 터지는 경우 방지.
local load_string = load or function()
	logger_util.warning('LINQ: Neither loadstring nor load are defined!')
end

--#endregion



function linq.is_linq(obj)
	return getmetatable(obj) and getmetatable(obj).__index == linq
end



function linq.lambda(expr)
	local args, rets = expr:match(lambda_pattern)
	local chunk, err

	if args and rets then
		local newrets = rets:match(return_pattern)
		if newrets == rets then
			rets = rets:sub(2, #rets - 1)
		end

		chunk, err = load_string(
			([[return function(%s) return %s end]]):format(args, rets)
		)
	else
		chunk, err = load_string(
			([[return function(v, k) return %s end]]):format(expr)
		)
	end

	if not chunk then
		logger_util.warning('LINQ: Invalid lambda expression!')
	end

	return chunk()
end



---	LINQ 생성자
function linq.from(...)
	return linq.new(...)
end



--- 일반적인 생성자 (`from`).
--- 시퀀싱이 가능한 테이블을 넘겨주면 됨.
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.new(...)
	local values = {...}

	if #values == 0 then
		return linq.empty()
	elseif #values == 1 then
		local source = values[1]

		if type(source) == 'table' then
			if linq.is_linq(source) then
				return source
			else
				if source[1] then
					return linq.array(source)
				else
					return linq.table(source)
				end
			end
		elseif type(source) == 'function' then
			return linq.iterator(source)
		end
	end

	return linq.params(...)
end



--- Range 생성자 [start, start + count]
---@param start number 시작하는 인덱스
---@param count number start로부터 몇번째 요소까지인지
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.range(start, count)
	if type(start) ~= 'number' then
		logger_util.warning([[LINQ: First argument 'start' must be a number!]])
	end

	if type(count) ~= 'number' or count < 0 then
		logger_util.warning([[Second argument 'count' must be a positive number!]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local progress = 0

		return function()
			if progress < count then
				progress = progress + 1
				return progress + start - 1, progress
			end
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



-- 비어있는 시퀀스(캐싱되어있음)를 내보냄.
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.empty()
	if not empty_sequence then
		empty_sequence = linq.params()
	end

	return empty_sequence
end



-- Iterator constructor. 
-- iterator로 부터 LINQ 시퀀스를 생성함.
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.iterator(func)
	local values = {}
	local overall = 0

	local function factory()
		local progress = 0

		return function()
			local value, index

			progress = progress + 1
			if progress > overall then
				value, index = func()
				overall = overall + 1
				values[overall] = { value = value, index = index }
			else
				value, index = values[progress].value, values[progress].index
			end

			if value then
				return value, index or progress
			end
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



--- Factory 생성자 함수. 팩토리 함수 내용에 따라 알맞는 LinqSequence를 반환함.
--- 다른 생성자 함수 내부에서 호출되는 생성자. 
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.factory(fac)
	return setmetatable({}, { 
		__call = fac, 
		__index = linq,
		__len = function(self) 
			return self:count()
		end,
		__concat = function(self, other)
			return self:concat(other)
		end,
		__pairs = function(self)
			return function(it)
				local v, k = it()
				return k, v
			end, self:get_iterator(), nil
		end,
	})
end



-- Repeat constructor. 
-- 특정 값을, 특정 횟수만큼 반복한 집합을 만듬.
-- ex) linq.rep(2, 4) => { 2, 2, 2, 2 }
---@return table
function linq.rep(value, count)
	if type(count) ~= 'number' or count < 0 then
		logger_util.warning([[Second argument 'count' must be a positive number!"]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local progress = 0

		return function()
			if progress < count then
				progress = progress + 1
				return value, progress
			end
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



-- 파라미터 생성자.
-- 인자로 넣은 값을 모두 포함한 Linq Sequence를 생성함.
-- tip: `linq.params(1, 2, 3)` 와 `linq.array{1, 2, 3}`는 완전히 동일한 결과를 반환함.
---@return LinqSequence
function linq.params(...)
	local values = {...}

	local function factory()
		local progress = 0
		return function()
			progress = progress + 1
			local v = values[progress]
			return v, v and progress or nil
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



-- Table 생성자
function linq.table(t)
	if type(t) ~= 'table' then
		logger_util.warning([[First argument 't' must be a table!]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local next, tab, start = pairs(t)
		local cont = true

		return function()
			if cont then
				local key, value = next(tab, start)
				if key == nil then
					cont = false
				else
					start = key
				end

				return value, key
			else
				return nil, nil
			end
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



-- Array 생성자
function linq.array(t)
	if type(t) ~= 'table' then
		logger_util.warning([[First argument 't' must be a table!]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local next, tab, start = ipairs(t)

		return function()
			if start ~= nil then
				local v
				start, v = next(tab, start)
				return v, start
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end



-- 판단에 만족되는 모든 엔트리들을 포함하고 있는 시퀀스를 반환함.
function linq:where(predicate)
	if type(predicate) == 'string' then
		predicate = linq.lambda(predicate)
	end

	if type(predicate) ~= 'function' then
		logger_util.warning([[First argument 'predicate' must be a function or lambda!]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local it = self()

		return function()
			local value, index
			repeat
				value, index = it()
			until index == nil or predicate(value, index)

			return value, index
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end

-- selector 구문의 내용에 따라, 기존 시퀀스와는 다른 형태의 key, value 값이 반환될 수 있음.
function linq:select(selector)
	if type(selector) == 'string' then
		selector = linq.lambda(selector)
	end

	if type(selector) ~= 'function' then
		logger_util.warning([[First argument 'selector' must be a function or lambda!]])
	end

	local function factory()
		local it = self()

		return function()
			local value, index = it()

			if value ~= nil then
				local v, i = selector(value, index)
				return v, i and i or index
			end

			return nil, nil
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)

function linq:select_many(collection_selector, result_selector)
	if type(collection_selector) == 'string' then
		collection_selector = linq.lambda(collection_selector)
	end

	if type(result_selector) == 'string' then
		result_selector = linq.lambda(result_selector)

	if type(collection_selector) ~= 'function' then

		local progress = 0
		local done = false

		return function()
			if done then

			progress = progress + 1

			local value, index = it()
			while index ~= nil do

				if #current_batch < size then

				else
					break
				end
			end

			if index == nil then
				done = true

				if #current_batch == 0 then
					return nil, nil
				end
			end

			return current_batch, progress
		end
	end

function linq:distinct_by(selector)
	if type(selector) == 'string' then
		selector = linq.lambda(selector)
	end

	local function factory()
		local it = self()
		local seen = {}

		return function()
			local value, index, key
			
			while index == nil do
				value, index = it()
				
				if (not seen[key]) then
                    break
                end
                
				key = selector(value)
			end

			if key ~= nil then

			end

			return value, index
		end
	end

	return linq.factory(factory)
end

		logger_util.warning([[First argument 'count' must be a positive number!]])
	end

		local progress = 0

		return function()
			while progress < count do
				local value, index = it()
				progress = progress + 1

				if index == nil then
					return
				end
			end

			return it()
		end
	end

function linq:aggregate(seed, selector)
	local empty = {}
	if seed and not selector then
		seed, selector = empty, seed
	end
	
	if type(selector) == 'string' then
		selector = linq.lambda(selector)
	end
	
	if type(selector) ~= 'function' then
		logger_util.warning([[Parameter 'selector' must be a function or lambda!]])
	end
	
	local it = self()
	repeat
		local value, index = it()
		
		if index then
			if seed == empty then
				seed = value
			else
				seed = selector(seed, value)
			end
		end
	until index == nil
	
	return seed
end

function local_class:publish_enhance_heal_attack(dt)
	local objects = self.enhance_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	local norm = vector(self.target_dir.z, 0, -self.target_dir.x)

	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_character_fo(fo)
				and not fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead
				and fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
				and fo ~= self.character then

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position))
				if vector_util.dot(dir, norm) >= 0 then
					dir = norm
				else
					dir = -norm
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.enhance_heal_attack_modifier
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.enhance_heal_attack_knock_back_force
				damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_dark_01')
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			elseif battle_util.is_friendly_target(self.character, fo) then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('target', fo.Position)
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
				heal_info.heal = math.floor(fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.enhance_heal_ratio)
				heal_info.sender = self.character
				heal_info.target = fo

				local cmd = CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info)
				command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end

	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:determine_target()
	local new_target = nil
	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	if battle ~= nil then
		local current_distance = 99999
		for i = 0, battle.Enemies.Count - 1 do
			local monster = battle.Enemies[i].Character
			if monster ~= self.character
					and not monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
					and monster.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
					and monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.target_hp_ratio
					and vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, monster.Position) < current_distance then

					current_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, monster.Position)
					new_target = monster
			end
		end

		if new_target == nil then
			local current_ratio = -1
			current_distance = 999999
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				if not user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
						and (user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio > current_ratio
							or user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio == current_ratio and current_distance < vector_util.distance(user_party[i].Position, self.character.Position)) then
					current_distance = vector_util.distance(user_party[i].Position, self.character.Position)
					current_ratio = user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio
					new_target = user_party[i]

				end
			end
		end
	end

	if new_target == nil then
		new_target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	end

	self.target = new_target
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		else
			self:determine_target()
			if self.target == nil then
				self:cancel()
				return
			end

			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
			if self.target_dir == vector_util.zero then
				self.target_dir = vector_util.back
			end
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
			end

			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed > self.shoot_duration then
			if self.current_shoot_count < self.normal_shoot_count then
				self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1
				self:change_state(self.state.cast)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.cast_enhance)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_enhance then

		if self.time_passed > self.enhance_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_enhance)
		else
			self:determine_target()
			if self.target == nil then
				self:cancel()
				return
			end

			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
			if self.target_dir == vector_util.zero then
				self.target_dir = vector_util.back
			end
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.enhance_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.enhance_attack_range)
			end

			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_enhance then
		if self.time_passed > self.enhance_shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:publish_enhance_heal_attack(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.target == nil or hit_info.target == self.character then
		return true
	end

	if label == self.normal_label then
		if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
			if battle_util.is_friendly_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('target', hit_info.target.Position)
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
				heal_info.heal = math.floor(hit_info.target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.normal_heal_ratio)
				heal_info.sender = self.character
				heal_info.target = hit_info.target

				local cmd = CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info)
				command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, cmd)
			else
				self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.enhance_attack_range = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		if self.target_dir == vector_util.zero then
			self.target_dir = vector_util.back
		end
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.charge_attack_range)
		end

		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.charge_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast_charge')
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('charge')
		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('charge', self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_dir, self.character.Transform)
		self.charge_trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('trail', self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_dir, self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.charge_calculator:Start()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
		else
			if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration + self.slash_ani_play_time_offset and self.time_passed - dt < self.cast_duration + self.slash_ani_play_time_offset then
				self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('slash_' .. self.current_slash_count)
			end

			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
			if self.target_dir == vector_util.zero then
				self.target_dir = vector_util.back
			end

			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_duration then
			if self.current_slash_count < self.slash_count then
				self.current_slash_count = self.current_slash_count + 1
				self:change_state(self.state.cast)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.cast_charge)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_charge then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		else
			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
			if self.target_dir == vector_util.zero then
				self.target_dir = vector_util.back
			end

			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.charge_attack_range)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed > self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_charge(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), true)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	self.charge_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

	local objects = self.charge_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo))

			if direction == nil then
				direction = vector_util.back
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_monster_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.charge_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.target = target

	self.current_pos = self.start_pos

	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.time_passed < 0 then
		return
	end

	if self.target_pos == nil then
		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		self.start_pos = self.target_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * self.fall_height
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)

	self.current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)

		self.action:on_fall_complete(self)
	end

	self.current_pos = nil
	self.start_pos = nil

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		local is_up = self.character.Position.z < self.zone_bound.center.z
		--local is_right = target_diff.x > 0
		--local is_clockwise = is_up and not is_right or is_right

				or unity_class.mathf.Atan2(target_diff.x, -target_diff.z)
		target_rad = math.min(math.abs(target_rad), self.max_charge_dir_rad) * (target_rad < 0 and -1 or 1)
		local z_dir = is_up and unity_class.vector3.forward or unity_class.vector3.back
		local pos = self.character.Position
		self.charge_dir = self:rotate_vector_xz(target_rad, z_dir)

		end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_rocks(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 충돌 대기
		if self.crashed then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

		-- 돌진 업데이트
		self:update_charge(dt)

		-- 시간 너무 많이 지나면 멈춤
		if self.time_passed > 10 then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_rocks(dt)

		rock:update_frame(dt)
	end

	rock:deactivate()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('rock_break', fall_pos)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(fall_pos, self.rock_radius)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end
		local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - fall_pos))
		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.rock_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction

		local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
		ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
		ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_dir), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Bounds.center
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			if self.knock_back_factor > 0 then
				-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
				local is_left = self.charge_dir:GetXz():IsClockWise(direction:GetXz())
				local knock_direction = is_left and unity_class.vector3(self.charge_dir.z, 0, -self.charge_dir.x)
						or unity_class.vector3(-self.charge_dir.z, 0, self.charge_dir.x)

				damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
				damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
		return false
	end

	-- 전투 입장한 순서 대로만 타겟팅 함
	table.insert(self.rock_target_list, {fo = fo, battle_id = e.BattleInstanceId})

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
		self.rock_target_list = {}
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) then
		return false
	end

	local battle_id = e.BattleInstanceId
	for i = #self.rock_target_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		local target_info = self.rock_target_list[i]
		if target_info.battle_id ~= battle_id then
			break
		end

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target_info.fo, fo) then
			break
		end

		table.remove(self.rock_target_list, i)
	until true end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.action then
		return false
	end

	if e:GetType() ~= typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		return false
	end

	local blocker = e.Blocker
	if is_unity_null(blocker) then
		return false
	end

	if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() ~= typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 충돌 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

	self.crashed = true

	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local target_num = #self.rock_target_list
	local min_index = math.max(1, target_num - self.rock_amount + 1)
	for i = target_num, min_index, -1 do repeat
		local target_info = self.rock_target_list[i]
		if target_info.battle_id ~= battle.BattleInstanceId then
			break
		end

		local random_delay = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, 0.5)
		local rock_fall, attack_range = self:get_rock_fall()
		if rock_fall ~= nil then
			local rock_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('rock_proj', unity_class.vector3(999,0,999))
			rock_fall:activate(random_delay, target_info.fo, rock_fx, attack_range)
		end
	until true end

	self:change_state(self.state.post)

	return false
end

function local_class:get_rock_fall()
	-- rock_fall_list와 attack_range_table 길이는 같아야 함
	for i = 1, #self.rock_fall_list do
		if not self.rock_fall_list[i].is_active then
			return self.rock_fall_list[i], self.attack_range_table[i]
		end
	end
	return nil,nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent))

	self:cancel()

	if self.rock_fall_list then
		for _, rock in ipairs(self.rock_fall_list) do
			rock:dispose()
		end
		self.rock_fall_list = nil
	end
	rock_fall_class:unset_param()
	self.attack_range_table = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.rock_target_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_ray_dist_to_bound(pos, dir_vector3)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(pos.x, pos.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > self.zone_bound.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < self.zone_bound.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > self.zone_bound.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < self.zone_bound.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function local_class:rotate_vector_xz(rad, v)
	local x = math.cos(rad) * v.x - math.sin(rad) * v.z
	local z = math.sin(rad) * v.x + math.cos(rad) * v.z
	return unity_class.vector3(x, v.y, z)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			--CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		--CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then

				end

				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo

				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knock_back_force = nil

	end

	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	local origin = unity_class.vector2(is_right and bound.max.x or bound.min.x, is_up and bound.max.z or bound.min.z)

	elseif dir.x > 0 and math.abs(origin.x - self.zone_bound.max.x) < constants.epsilon then
		return self.direction.right
	end
	return self.direction.none

	end

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
		dir = unity_class.vector3.forward
	end

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir

	damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
	damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * knockback_force

	local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
	ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
	ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)

function local_class:get_bound_crash_side(bound, dir_vector3)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)
	local is_up = dir.y > 0
	local is_right = dir.x > 0
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(is_right and bound.max.x or bound.min.x, is_up and bound.max.z or bound.min.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and math.abs(origin.y - self.zone_bound.min.z) < constants.epsilon then
		return self.direction.down
	elseif dir.y > 0 and math.abs(origin.y - self.zone_bound.max.z) < constants.epsilon then
		return self.direction.up
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and math.abs(origin.x - self.zone_bound.min.x) < constants.epsilon then
		return self.direction.left
	elseif dir.x > 0 and math.abs(origin.x - self.zone_bound.max.x) < constants.epsilon then
		return self.direction.right
	end
	return self.direction.none
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.level = level

	-- parameters
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)

		self.damage_timings = {0.4, 0.55, 0.7, 0.7}
	end

	if self.damage_modifiers == nil then
		self.damage_modifiers = {1, 1, 1, 2}
	end

	-- states
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.fall_finish = true
	self.current_height = 0
	self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.character.Position)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.fall_finish = false
		self.current_height = self.appear_height
		self.character.Position = self.target.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.current_height
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- update
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- fall
		if self.fall_finish == false then
			local move = self.fall_speed * self.time_passed + self.fall_acc * self.time_passed * self.time_passed / 2

			if move >= self.appear_height then
				self.fall_finish = true
				self.current_height = 0

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("attack", self.target.Position)
			else
				self.current_height = self.appear_height - move
			end

			self.character.Position = self.target.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.current_height
		end

		-- damage
		for index = 1, #self.damage_timings do
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, self.time_passed, self.damage_timings[index]) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = self.target
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifiers[index]
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			-- 대상 처치시 재사용 처리
			if self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == true then
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "reset_fatal_strike" }))
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.appear_height = nil

	self.damage_timings = nil
	self.damage_modifiers = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:start(info)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.shot_time = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_shot_count = 0

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		-- 다음스테이트아 실제 실행 스테이트
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--임시 어택레인지 받아서 위치 업데이트에 사용함.
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.current_attack_range = self:prepare_shot()
		self.current_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.projectile_land_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.current_attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_time = 0
		self:shoot_to_manual()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:remove_shots()
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then--준비모션 실행

		if self.current_attack_range ~= nil then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.current_attack_range, self.target.Position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.current_attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then-- 실제 액션 실행 ( 스포트라이트 실행 밎 캐릭터 추적
		self.shot_time = self.shot_time + dt
		if self.shot_time >= self.explosion_interval then
			-- 인터벌당 폭발
			-- 카운트까지 쏘고나면 post 로 이행
			if self.current_shot_count >= self.shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then--뒷정리..
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--prepared 끝난 이후에 발사 위치를 확정 지어야 한다.
function local_class:prepare_shot()

	local range = self:get_fall_range()
	range:Hide()
	--타격위치
	table.insert(self.shots, {
		--발사시작 위치 준비시간 끝났을때의 타겟 위치 + y + 10?
		start_position = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		--목표위치
		target_position = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		--발사후 지난시간
		time_passed = 0,
		--발사 되었는가
		is_launched = false,
		--레이블
		label = 0,
		--발사 레인지 이펙트
		attack_range = range
	})

end

function local_class:shoot_to_manual()
	self.shot_time = 0
	if self.shots ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.shots do
			if not self.shots[i].is_launched then
				-- 현재의 어택레인지 위치 업데이트 종료 하기 위해서 비워줌
				self.current_attack_range = nil
				-- 발사시점에 위치 확정
				self.shots[i].start_position =  unity_class.vector3(self.target.Position.x, self.target.Position.y + self.start_height, self.target.Position.z)
				self.shots[i].target_position = self.target.Position
				self.shots[i].is_launched = true
				self.shots[i].label = i
				-- 시작위치, 타겟위치, 레이블, 중간계산?

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action_key, self.shots[i].start_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key, self.character)

				local start = self.shots[i].start_position
				local target = self.shots[i].target_position

				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(start, vector_util.normalized(target - start), self.shots[i].label,
						vector_util.distance(start, target), nil, false, 0, target)
				self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:damage_shot(label)

	-- 폭파된 어택레인지 제거
	for _, v in pairs(self.shots) do
		if v.label == label then
			self:return_fall_range(v.attack_range)
			v.attack_range = nil
		end
	end
	-- 데미지 처리는 프로젝타일 내부에서 진행하도록 변경
end

function local_class:remove_shots()
	for i = #self.shots, 1, -1 do
		-- 어택레인지 반환
		if self.shots[i].attack_range ~= nil then
			self:return_fall_range(self.shots[i].attack_range)
			self.shots[i].attack_range = nil
		end
		-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
		table.remove(self.shots, i)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		if hit_info.hitType == CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.ForceEliminate then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			self:damage_shot(label)
			-- 사운드 처리 프로젝타일 내부에서 진행 되도록 변경
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	if range == nil then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end

function local_class:force_cancel()

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then

		end

	self.post_duration = nil
