	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:calculate_inhale_souls_position()
		--이 시점에 발사 위치 확정
		self:prepare_inhale()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		-- 다음스테이트아 실제 실행 스테이트
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.inhale then
		--흡수 이펙트 캐릭터에 하나만 생성되도록 수정
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.aura_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self:calculate_exhale_souls_position()
		self:prepare_exhale()
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charging) then
			self.fx_charging:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charging = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exhale then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local dest_pos = self.zone_bounds.center
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(dest_pos - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(dest_pos, self.character.Position)
		self.prev_progress = 0
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		--캐릭터 중앙으로 이동
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.inhale then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_inhale()
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.fx_charging = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charging_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charging_key, self.character.Bounds.center)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:remove_inhale()
	elseif next_state == self.state.exhale then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.release_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_exhale()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:remove_exhale()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_phase(phase)
	self.current_phase = phase
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:calculate_inhale_souls_position()
	--inhale 시작위치 및 exhale 아웃위치 계산 / 지정
	if self.inhale_start_positions ~= nil then
		for i = #self.inhale_start_positions, 1, -1 do
			self.inhale_start_positions[i] = nil
			table.remove(self.inhale_start_positions, i)
		end
	end
	self.inhale_start_positions = { }

	-- zone bound 4등분 해서 저장
	local center = self.zone_bounds.center
	local modX = self.zone_bounds.size.x / 2
	local modZ = self.zone_bounds.size.z / 2
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_bounds.size.y, modZ)

	local quadrant_1 = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size)
	local quadrant_2 = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size)
	local quadrant_3 = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size)
	local quadrant_4 = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size)

	--맵 중앙과 바운드 max 까지의 길이를 기준으로 원형배치로 변경
	-- 정사각형이 아니므로 방향 각각 계산 해야 할듯.
	local pos1 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_1.min.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_1.max.z)
	local distance = vector_util.distance(center, pos1)
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos1 - center), 0)
	pos1 = center + direction * distance
	pos1.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos1)

	local pos2 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_1.max.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_1.max.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos2 - center), 0)
	pos2 = center + direction * distance
	pos2.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos2)

	local pos3 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_2.max.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_2.max.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos3 - center), 0)
	pos3 = center + direction * distance
	pos3.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos3)

	local pos4 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_2.max.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_2.min.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos4 - center), 0)
	pos4 = center + direction * distance
	pos4.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos4)

	local pos5 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_4.max.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_4.min.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos5 - center), 0)
	pos5 = center + direction * distance
	pos5.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos5)

	local pos6 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_4.min.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_4.min.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos6 - center), 0)
	pos6 = center + direction * distance
	pos6.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos6)

	local pos7 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_3.min.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_3.min.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos7 - center), 0)
	pos7 = center + direction * distance
	pos7.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos7)

	local pos8 = unity_class.vector3(quadrant_3.min.x, self.character.Position.y, quadrant_3.max.z)
	direction = vector_util.get_x0z(vector_util.normalized(pos8 - center), 0)
	pos8 = center + direction * distance
	pos8.y = 0
	table.insert(self.inhale_start_positions, pos8)

	--흡수시에는 중앙에서 보스 중앙 까지 전진하도록 한다.
	self.inhale_end_position = self.character.Bounds.center
end

function local_class:calculate_exhale_souls_position()
	-- 로직 변경
	-- 보스에서 캐릭터 방향을 기준으로 잡고 첫번째 발사 위치 확정 후 , 보스기준으로 45도씩 돌려가며 원형으로 발사하게 됨
	if self.exhale_end_positions ~= nil then
		for i = #self.exhale_end_positions, 1, -1 do
			self.exhale_end_positions[i] = nil
			table.remove(self.exhale_end_positions, i)
		end
	end

	local modX = self.zone_bounds.size.x / 2
	self.exhale_start_position = self.character.Bounds.center

	local target_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.character.Position - self.target.Position)
	target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target_direction, 0)
	local rot_quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0)

	-- 방출 목적지
	self.exhale_end_positions = { }
	for i = 1, 8 do
		target_direction = rot_quaternion * target_direction
		local ex_pos = self.exhale_start_position + target_direction * modX
		ex_pos.y = 0
		table.insert(self.exhale_end_positions, ex_pos)
	end
end
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 포격 업데이트
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then--캐릭터 중앙으로 이동
		--내부에서 종료 체크
		self:update_move()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then--준비모션 실행
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.inhale)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.inhale then-- 흡수

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then-- 대기
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.exhale)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exhale then-- 흡수
		self:move_exhale()
		if self.time_passed >= self.exhale_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then--뒷정리..
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move()
	--중앙으로 이동.

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	if progress >= 1 or vector_util.sqr_distance(self.character.Position, self.zone_bounds.center) <= 0.01 then
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_inhale()
	for i = 1, self.inhale_soul_count do
		local info = {
			is_launched = false,
			start_position = self.inhale_start_positions[i],
			is_reached = false,
			label = 7700 + i,
			aoe_position = unity_class.vector3.zero,
			end_position = self.inhale_end_position
		}
		-- 2페이즈에 쓰일 장판 위치 세팅
		-- 장판 직사각형 하나만 세팅되도록 수정됨.
		local start_pos = info.start_position
		start_pos.y = 0
		local end_pos = info.end_position
		end_pos.y = 0
		local distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, end_pos)
		info.aoe_position = start_pos + (vector_util.normalized(end_pos - start_pos) * (distance / 2))

		table.insert(self.inhale_souls, info)
	end
end
-- 공격범위 표시 없이 바로 세팅 해서 발사 가능함..
function local_class:shoot_inhale()
	for i = 1, self.inhale_soul_count do
		if not self.inhale_souls[i].is_launched then
			self.inhale_souls[i].is_launched = true
			local start = self.inhale_souls[i].start_position
			local target = self.inhale_souls[i].end_position
			-- 이펙트

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('inhale', start)
			self.shoot_helper_in:ShootDirectionAtPosition(start, vector_util.normalized(target - start), self.inhale_souls[i].label,
					vector_util.distance(start, target), nil, false, 0, target)
			-- 2페이즈 일 경우 발사와 동시에 장판 설치
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.enhance then
				self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = vector_util.normalized(target - start)
				local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue(self.field_key)
				if has_value then
					sfx_info.playPosition = self.inhale_souls[i].aoe_position
					sfx_info.parent = nil
				end

				stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.inhale_souls[i].aoe_position, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool(self.field_key), self.aoe_spec, nil, sfx_info, nil)
				--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.field_key, self.inhale_souls[i].aoe_position)
				table.insert(self.active_explosions, self.inhale_souls[i].aoe_position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_exhale()
	for i = 1, self.exhale_soul_count do
		local info = {
			is_launched = false,
			start_position = self.exhale_start_position,
			label = 7600 + i,
			--목표지점에 도착 했는지
			is_reached = false,
			end_position = self.exhale_end_positions[i]
		}
		table.insert(self.exhale_souls, info)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_exhale()
	for i = 1, self.exhale_soul_count do
		if not self.exhale_souls[i].is_launched then
			self.exhale_souls[i].is_launched = true
			local start = self.exhale_souls[i].start_position
			local target = self.exhale_souls[i].end_position

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('exhale', start)
			self.shoot_helper_out:ShootDirectionAtPosition(start, vector_util.normalized(target - start), self.exhale_souls[i].label,
					vector_util.distance(start, target), nil, false, 0, target)
		end
	end
end

--발사된 Soul 리스트 위치 업데이트
function local_class:check_inhale(label)
	if self.inhale_souls ~= nil then
		for i = #self.inhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			-- 발사된 샷만 계산 함..
			if self.inhale_souls[i].is_launched and label == self.inhale_souls[i].label then
				self.inhale_souls[i].is_reached = true
			end
		end

		local is_end = true
		--전부 동작 끝났다면 다음단계
		for i = #self.inhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			if not self.inhale_souls[i].is_reached then
				is_end = false
			end
		end

		if is_end then
			if  self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:remove_aoe()
	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	for i = #self.active_explosions, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.active_explosions, i)
	end
end

function local_class:move_exhale()
	if self.exhale_souls ~= nil then
		for i = #self.exhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			-- 발사된 샷만 계산 함..
			if self.exhale_souls[i].is_launched then
				local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.exhale_duration)
				progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)

				if progress >= 1 then
					self.exhale_souls[i].is_reached = true
				end
			end
		end

		local is_end = true
		--전부 동작 끝났다면 다음단계
		for i = #self.exhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			if not self.exhale_souls[i].is_reached then
				is_end = false
			end
		end

		if is_end then
			if  self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_inhale()
	if self.inhale_souls ~= nil then
		for i = #self.inhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(self.inhale_souls, i)
		end
	end
	self.inhale_souls = { }
end

function local_class:remove_exhale()
	if self.exhale_souls ~= nil then
		for i = #self.exhale_souls, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(self.exhale_souls, i)
		end
	end
	self.exhale_souls = { }
end


function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label >= 7700 and label < 7800 then
		if self.shoot_helper_in ~= nil then

			for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, v) then
					hit_info.attackModifier = hit_info.attackModifier * self.damage_modifier
					self.shoot_helper_in:OnHit(hit_info)
					-- 관통하면서 데미지 줄 수 있도록 false 리턴
					return false
				end
			end

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.target) then
				hit_info.attackModifier = hit_info.attackModifier * self.damage_modifier
				self.shoot_helper_in:OnHit(hit_info)
				return false
			end
			--프로젝타일이 종료위치에 도달하면 ForceEliminate 타입으로 on_hit 호출되므로 해당 위치에 종료 이펙트 출력함.
			if hit_info.hitType == CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.ForceEliminate then
				self:check_inhale(label)
			end
		end
	end

	if label >= 7600 and label < 7700 then
		if self.shoot_helper_out ~= nil then

			for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, v) then
					self.shoot_helper_out:OnHit(hit_info)
					return false
				end
			end
			-- 타겟이 유저파티가 아닐 경우가 있음.
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.target) then
				hit_info.attackModifier = hit_info.attackModifier * self.damage_modifier
				self.shoot_helper_in:OnHit(hit_info)
				return false
			end

		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self:remove_aoe()
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charging) then
		self.fx_charging:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_charging = nil
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:remove_inhale()
	self:remove_exhale()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.interval = nil
	self.exhale_duration = nil
	self.aoe_width = nil
	self.aoe_length = nil
	self.move_duration = nil
	self.projectile_in_name = nil
	self.projectile_out_name = nil
	self.shoot_helper_in = nil
	self.shoot_helper_out = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.inhale_souls = nil
	self.exhale_souls = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.active_explosions = nil
	self.phase = nil
	self.current_phase = nil
	self.move_direction = nil
	self.move_distance = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.action_key = nil
	self.post_ket = nil
	self.aoe_key = nil
	self.field_key = nil
	self.aura_key = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.fx_dust = nil

	self.sfx_burrow1 = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

--- 명시적으로 서브면 2, 메인이면 1 쓰도록 함 (어차피 1개만 씀)
function local_class:set_tentacle_variation(is_sub)
	local tentacle

	if (is_sub == true) then
		tentacle = stage:GetCharacter('aw_ceo_tentacle_2')
	else
		tentacle = stage:GetCharacter('aw_ceo_tentacle_1')
	end

	if not is_unity_null(tentacle) then
		character_util.set_active_state(tentacle, 'disabled')
		self.tentacle = tentacle
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

--촉수 하나만 사용하도록 변경
function local_class:set_tentacle()
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local tentacle = stage:GetCharacter('aw_ceo_tentacle_'..i)
		if not is_unity_null(tentacle) then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('summon', tentacle)
			character_util.set_active_state(tentacle, 'disabled')
			table.insert(self.tentacles, tentacle)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_tentacle()
	for _, v in pairs(self.tentacles) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) and v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			return v
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()

	self:cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
		self.fx_dust:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_dust = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide(0)
	end

	if self.sfx_burrow1 ~= nil then
		self.sfx_burrow1:Stop()
		self.sfx_burrow1 = nil
	end

end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 캐릭터 쫒아다니는 이펙트 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
			self.fx_dust:Dispose()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end
		if self.sfx_burrow1 ~= nil then
			self.sfx_burrow1:Stop()
			self.sfx_burrow1 = nil
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.burrow_key, self.target.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.sfx_burrow1 = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('sand1')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--촉수 생성
		self:instantiate_tentacle()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
			self.fx_dust.transform.position = self.target.Position
		end
		self.sfx_burrow1:SetPosition(self.target.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:instantiate_tentacle()
	if self.tentacle ~= nil then
		if  self.tentacle.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.tentacle,'enabled')
			-- 죽어있으면 치료후 데려옴
			if self.tentacle.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				-- 힐
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
				heal_info.heal = self.tentacle.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
				heal_info.isRevive = true
				heal_info.skipEffect = true
				heal_info.sender = self.character
				heal_info.target = self.tentacle
				command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
			end

			-- 초기 소환 루틴
			self.tentacle.Position = self.target.Position
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.summon_key, self.tentacle.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('out1', self.tentacle.Position)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('out2', self.tentacle.Position)
			--여기서 촉수 애니메이션 재생 했더니 내 캐릭터 모션이 멈춤..
			--소환범위 데미지 처리
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.tentacle.Position, self.summon_radius)
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) then
					local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.tentacle.Position).normalized

					if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
						dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
					damage_info.modifier = 0
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(self.tentacle, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(self.tentacle.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(self.tentacle, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.tentacle = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
